an4.232:1.1: cattārīmāni bhikkhave kammāni mayā sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā paveditāni
an4.232:1.5: atthi bhikkhave kammaṃ kaṇhaṃ sukkaṃ kaṇhasukkavipākaṃ
an4.232:1.6: atthi bhikkhave kammaṃ akaṇhaṃ asukkaṃ akaṇhaasukkavipākaṃ kammakkhayāya saṃvattati
an4.232:1.7: imāni kho bhikkhave cattāri kammāni mayā sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā paveditānīti.
